label: Feishu
description: Sessions use feishu-cli as you, through Foundry's gateway; the login stays on the server.

descriptions.en: Sessions use feishu-cli as you, through Foundry's gateway; the login stays on the server.
descriptions.zh-CN: 会话以你的身份使用 feishu-cli，经 Foundry 网关调用；登录保存在服务器上。

label: Cloudflare
description: Sessions read the zones you allow, and change DNS where you allow it, through Foundry's gateway.

descriptions.en: Sessions read the zones you allow, and change DNS where you allow it, through Foundry's gateway.
descriptions.zh-CN: 会话经 Foundry 网关读取你允许的 zone，并在你允许时修改 DNS。

label: AWS CLI
description: Sessions on a device run the aws command with that device's own sign-in.

descriptions.en: Sessions on a device run the aws command with that device's own sign-in.
descriptions.zh-CN: 设备上的会话用那台设备自己的登录运行 aws 命令。

methods.label: AWS console sign-in
methods.description: Sign in on the AWS page in this browser, then paste the code it shows.

descriptions.en: Sign in on the AWS page in this browser, then paste the code it shows.
descriptions.zh-CN: 在这个浏览器里的 AWS 页面上登录，再把页面显示的授权码粘贴回来。

fields.label: Default AWS Region
fields.help: Signing in covers every Region your account allows; commands that name none use this one.

helps.en: Signing in covers every Region your account allows; commands that name none use this one.
helps.zh-CN: 登录后可用账号允许的所有区域；命令没指定区域时用这个。

methods.label: IAM Identity Center
methods.description: Your AWS access portal. Foundry sets up the device's default profile and shows a code to approve.

descriptions.en: Your AWS access portal. Foundry sets up the device's default profile and shows a code to approve.
descriptions.zh-CN: 通过 AWS 访问门户登录。Foundry 在设备上设置默认 profile，并给出一个待批准的登录码。

methods.label: In a terminal on the device

labels.en: In a terminal on the device

methods.description: Run one of these on the device, then check again here. Access keys work too.

descriptions.en: Run one of these on the device, then check again here. Access keys work too.
descriptions.zh-CN: 在设备上运行下面的命令之一，再回到这里重新检查。也可以用访问密钥。

label: GitHub CLI
description: Sessions on a device run gh, and git over HTTPS to GitHub, with that device's own GitHub sign-in.

descriptions.en: Sessions on a device run gh, and git over HTTPS to GitHub, with that device's own GitHub sign-in.
descriptions.zh-CN: 设备上的会话用那台设备自己的 GitHub 登录运行 gh，经 HTTPS 访问 GitHub 的 git 也用它。

methods.label: Sign in with a code
methods.description: Foundry starts gh's sign-in on the device; enter the code on GitHub to approve. Git on the device then uses this login for GitHub too.

descriptions.en: Foundry starts gh's sign-in on the device; enter the code on GitHub to approve. Git on the device then uses this login for GitHub too.
descriptions.zh-CN: Foundry 在设备上启动 gh 登录；在 GitHub 上输入验证码批准。之后设备上的 git 访问 GitHub 也用这份登录。

methods.label: In a terminal on the device

labels.en: In a terminal on the device

methods.description: Run this on the device, then check again here.

descriptions.en: Run this on the device, then check again here.
descriptions.zh-CN: 在设备上运行下面的命令，再回到这里重新检查。
